meta.name: embedded-systems
meta.description: Use when developing firmware for microcontrollers, implementing RTOS applications, or optimizing power consumption. Invoke for STM32, ESP32, FreeRTOS, bare-metal, power optimization, real-time systems, configure peripherals, write interrupt handlers, implement DMA transfers, debug timing issues.

copy.tagline: 开发微控制器固件，优化功耗与实时性能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在为STM32或ESP32编写裸机或RTOS固件
copy.tagline_en: Develop firmware for microcontrollers, optimize power and real-time performance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are writing bare-metal or RTOS firmware for STM32 or ESP32

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会作为嵌入式工程师,为 STM32、ESP32 等单片机编写固件,输出驱动、中断处理、RTOS 任务和初始化代码;它会遵循内存优化、正确中断等约束,并附上资源使用说明。
howto.when: 当你要求编写单片机固件、实现 RTOS 应用或优化功耗时触发;涉及 STM32、ESP32、FreeRTOS 等场景也会接管。

say.text: 帮我为 STM32 写一个 GPIO 中断处理程序
say.note: 会输出中断处理代码和说明

say.text: 用 FreeRTOS 创建两个任务并通过队列通信
这个 ESP32 项目怎么降低功耗?
say.note: 会分析并提供优化建议

howto.what_en: After install, Claude works as an embedded engineer: it writes MCU firmware (STM32, ESP32) including drivers, ISRs, RTOS tasks, and init code, applies memory/interrupt constraints, and summarizes resource usage.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to develop MCU firmware, implement RTOS applications, or optimize power consumption; also for STM32, ESP32, FreeRTOS, etc.

say_en.text: Help me write a GPIO interrupt handler for STM32
Create two FreeRTOS tasks communicating via a queue
